parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value:
=You are an assistant for a WhatsApp task-management bot. Classify the message below into exactly one intent and extract the relevant fields.

Sender role: {{ $json.sender_role }} (admin = the person who delegates/creates tasks; assignee = the person tasks get assigned to).

Intents:
- CREATE_TASK: sender is assigning or creating a new task for someone, OR setting a reminder/task/to-do for themselves. Recognize varied natural phrasing, not just "assign X to Y" — also "remind me to X", "set a reminder to X", "I need to X by <time>", "don't let me forget to X", "note down that I have to X", "tell Y to do X".
- STATUS_UPDATE: sender is reporting progress or completion on an existing task (e.g. "I've started", "done", "completed the report", "finished it", "wrapped up the pipeline thing").
- RESCHEDULE: sender wants to change the due date/deadline of an existing task (e.g. "adjust deadline to tomorrow", "push it to 24 hours").
- ACKNOWLEDGE: sender is simply confirming they saw/received a task, without reporting progress or completion (e.g. "noted", "ok", "okay", "got it", "sure", "will do", "on it", "roger", "alright").
- OTHER: anything else (greetings, unclear requests, unrelated questions).

Respond with ONLY a JSON object containing exactly these keys:
assignee (CREATE_TASK only: lowercase first name of who the task is for if mentioned, else empty string — leave empty if the sender is reminding only themselves with no name mentioned)
task (CREATE_TASK only: short description of the task, else empty string)
due_date (CREATE_TASK only: due date/time exactly as mentioned e.g. "6pm today", else empty string if not mentioned)
priority (CREATE_TASK only: one of urgent/high/normal/low if mentioned, else empty string)
task_reference (STATUS_UPDATE, RESCHEDULE, or ACKNOWLEDGE only: short keywords identifying which task if mentioned, else empty string)
new_status (STATUS_UPDATE only: one of "started" or "completed", else empty string)
new_due_date (RESCHEDULE only: the new due date/time exactly as mentioned, else empty string)
intent (one of CREATE_TASK, STATUS_UPDATE, RESCHEDULE, ACKNOWLEDGE, CANCEL, GREETING, OTHER)

CANCEL = the sender wants to stop/undo a task or in-progress request (e.g. "never mind", "forget it", "cancel that", "don't do it", "scrap that task", "stop", "I changed my mind").
GREETING = a simple greeting or small talk with no task content (e.g. "hi", "hello", "hey there", "good morning", "how are you").

Base your answer only on the actual message text shown below, not on any prior example.

Message: {{  $json.text }}
Output:

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $('Match Task - Status Update').item.json.from, type: "text", text: { body: ($('Match Task - Status Update').item.json.my_open_tasks.length ? "I couldn't tell which task you meant. Your open tasks are:
- " + $('Match Task - Status Update').item.json.my_open_tasks.join("
- ") + "

Reply with the task name." : "Sorry, I couldn't find a matching task for "" + $('Match Task - Status Update').item.json.parsed_task_reference + "". Can you tell me the exact task name?") } } }}
={{ { status: "complete" } }}

={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $('Match Task - Status Update').item.json.from, type: "text", text: { body: "Nice work! Marked \"" + $('Match Task - Status Update').item.json.matched_task_name + "\" as completed." } } }}
={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: "2547XXXXXXXX", type: "text", text: { body: "Alex has completed the task: \"" + $('Match Task - Status Update').item.json.matched_task_name + "\"." } } }}
={{ { status: "in progress" } }}

={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $('Match Task - Status Update').item.json.from, type: "text", text: { body: "Got it — marked \"" + $('Match Task - Status Update').item.json.matched_task_name + "\" as in progress. Let me know when it's done!" } } }}

={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $json.from, type: "text", text: { body: "Sorry, I couldn't find a matching task for \"" + $json.parsed_task_reference + "\". Can you tell me the exact task name?" } } }}
={{ { due_date: $json.new_due_date_ms, due_date_time: true } }}
={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $json.from, type: "text", text: { body: "Done — \"" + $json.matched_task_name + "\" is now due " + $json.new_due_date_readable + "." } } }}

={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: "2547XXXXXXXX", type: "text", text: { body: "Heads up — the deadline for \"" + $json.matched_task_name + "\" has been changed to " + $json.new_due_date_readable + "." } } }}

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value:
=You are a date/time interpreter. The current date and time is {{ new Date().toString() }}.
A person replied with the following text when asked for a task's due date/deadline. It may contain typos or informal phrasing.

Text: {{ $('Handle Session Answer').item.json.raw_text }}

Work out what date/time they most likely meant, correcting for typos. Respond with ONLY a JSON object with one key:
hours_from_now: a number (may be decimal) of hours from right now until the deadline they meant, or null if you truly cannot determine any date/time from the text.
Output:

" (" + $('Match Task - Acknowledge').item.json.matched_due_date_formatted + ")" : "") + "." } } }}
={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $('Match Task - Acknowledge').item.json.from, type: "text", text: { body: "Got it \u2014 I've let Persival know you're on it!" } } }}
={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $('Clear Cancelled Session').item.json.from, type: "text", text: { body: "Okay, noted \u2014 let's not proceed with this task." } } }}

={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $('Match Task - Cancel').item.json.from, type: "text", text: { body: "Cancelled \"" + $('Match Task - Cancel').item.json.matched_task_name + "\"." + ($('Match Task - Cancel').item.json.notify_to_whatsapp ? " I've let the other person know." : "") } } }}

={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $('Match Task - Cancel').item.json.notify_to_whatsapp, type: "text", text: { body: $('Match Task - Cancel').item.json.sender_name + " cancelled the task \"" + $('Match Task - Cancel').item.json.matched_task_name + "\" \u2014 you don't need to proceed with it." } } }}

={{ { messaging_product: "whatsapp", to: $('Match Task - Cancel').item.json.from, type: "text", text: { body: $('Match Task - Cancel').item.json.my_open_tasks.length ? "I couldn't tell which task you meant to cancel. Your open tasks are:

Reply with the task name, or 'never mind' to drop it." : "I don't see anything open to cancel right now." } } }}
